title: Learn Your Sink
description: Identify the major parts under your sink before beginning repairs.

title: Turn Off Hot and Cold Water
description: Turn both shutoff valves clockwise until fully closed.
tip: Turn the valves gently. Do not force them.

title: Place a Bucket or Towels Under the Sink
description: Place a bucket or towels under the P-trap to catch any water that may spill out.
tip: A bucket is best, but towels can help absorb small spills.

title: Inspect the Leak Location
description: Dry the pipes and run a small amount of water to identify exactly where the leak starts.
tip: Run only a small amount of water so it is easier to spot the first leak.

title: Tighten the Slip-Joint Nuts
description: Hand-tighten the slip-joint nuts first. If needed, use adjustable channel locks to tighten gently.
tip: Over-tightening can crack the nuts or strip the threads.

title: Test for Leaks
description: Turn the water supply back on, run water, and check whether the leak has stopped.
tip: Check both the supply valves and all drain connections for any signs of moisture.
